tools.name: stage_room
tools.description: Queue virtual staging of one empty interior room from a public photo URL (https, JPG/PNG/WebP up to 15 MB). Returns an id to poll with stage_status. Furnished rooms, exteriors and photos with people are skipped. The public sampler stages up to 10 rooms a day for free.

tools.name: stage_status
tools.description: Check a queued staging job. Returns queued, working, delivered (with the labelled staged image URL and the original, valid 30 days), skipped (with the reason) or failed.
